## Result and mathematical scope

**Independent finite verification; no new kappa.** A code-disjoint vector-set oracle checks the historical binary-frame compiler and parity-side repair for ambient dimensions 0 through 6. Completed coverage: **3,290 subspaces**, **29,899 nondegenerate nested pairs**, and **1,634,803 ambient phase inputs**, each checked in both directions. It validates exact residual spans, characteristic-vector acceptance and returned orthonormal bases, including alternating endpoints and zero residuals. No defect was found in this finite domain.

Only `research/binary-residual-exhaustive/` is added. Existing sources, default commands, selected frontier and `upstream/` are unchanged. Selected conditional kappa remains `1661634653669567/10^18`.

## Validation

Python 3.10+, standard library only, from the repository root:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/binary-residual-exhaustive/verify.py
python3 -I -B research/binary-residual-exhaustive/test_verify.py
```

Expected marker: `PASS_BINARY_RESIDUAL_EXHAUSTIVE subspaces=3290 nested_pairs=29899 phase_inputs=1634803 controls=10 kappa=unchanged`.

The oracle uses complete vector sets and coordinate pairings, with no predecessor elimination or arithmetic imports. Each space has two presentations. A separate powerset enumeration of all 32,768 subsets of the nonzero F2^4 vectors agrees with the 67-space extension census; Gaussian-binomial dimension counts agree independently.

Ten explicit controls distinguish exact span from rank, orthogonality from unit norms, weight-three phases from unit phases, and forward from reverse edges. Faulty classification, characteristic, residual and orthonormal functions, omitted coverage, source drift and receipt-value/type corruption are detected.

Seven test groups pass normally and under `-O`, including a complete optimized replay in a minimal closure with spaces in its path. Unchanged predecessor sources are compiled explicitly with `optimize=0` to preserve assertions; direct historical execution under `-O` is not claimed. Normal/optimized receipts are byte-identical. Three relevant predecessor tests and selected-record integrity pass. Eleven predecessor/context inputs have SHA256 and exact base Git-blob pins. Published tree equals the tested local tree.

Executed on macOS arm64 / CPython 3.12.14. No Linux, hosted CI, whole-repository `make verify`, selected cold supplier replay or Lean result is claimed. PROOF.md separates written mathematical arguments from finite implementation evidence. SOURCES.json, EXPECTED.json and VALIDATION.json retain exact pins, full census and validation scope.

## Pins, overlap and attribution

Exact base: **f567884aeb8851b6e794af1184119a3bfbe1e631**. OS-random seed **83**, independent-verification track. The local claim records three candidates and the exhaustive stopping rule. Main refreshed unchanged. No sprint coordination issue exists in the inspected open-issue inventory; final PR refresh reached #906 and targeted all-state binary-frame/residual searches found no duplicate.

Credit **Douglas R. Colkitt** for the historical compiler/parity repair and **OpenAI's original manuscript** for orthonormal absorption and signed phases. PR771 checks full-space isometry orders/invoices, PR831 studies F4 phase interfaces, and PR712 checks one cold wrapper; this all-subspace/nested-pair census adds distinct evidence and imports none of their pending code. Selected PR799/PR741/PR589/PR555 ancestry remains credited in NOTICE.md.

Prepared for **ToikY** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance**, including a separately implemented set oracle and scoped AI mathematical/code reviews. Apache-2.0; predecessor notices retained. No independent human review claimed.

All inherited all-size/compiler, realization, hosting, precision/tape and analytic obligations remain. This does not establish a new supplier, optimum or full multiplication theorem.
title: Independent verification: exhaustive binary residual and phase-interface census (no new kappa)
